title: Recursive Decompose and Combine
summary: Solve a hierarchical problem by applying the same function to smaller child substructures and combining those child answers with local information.
recognition_signals: the input contains nested or hierarchical substructures
each child is a smaller instance of the same problem
the parent answer can be built from child answers plus local data
core_rules: Every recursive call must move to a strictly smaller subproblem.
The base case must return an identity or direct answer that makes the parent combination correct.
structural_steps: define the empty or smallest base case
combine child results with local state
return the combined result to the parent

common_confusions.distinction: Decompose/combine is the general recursive structure. DFS return-state reasoning focuses on choosing exactly what summary each subtree should return so its parent can compute a more complex answer.
